title: Discount Rate Change Front-Running
description: MEV bots can front-run setDiscountRate() transactions to capture favorable rates before they change. When admin submits a rate change, bots can observe and act on this information before regular users.
impact: Information asymmetry favoring sophisticated actors on rate changes. MEV bots gain unfair advantage by observing pending governance transactions.
attackPath: Admin submits setDiscountRate() to increase discount
MEV bot observes pending transaction in mempool
Bot front-runs with claim at old (worse) rate
Regular users now claim at new (better) rate
Or: bot front-runs rate decrease to capture better rate
recommendation: Implement a timelock for rate changes with advance notice. Alternatively, use private transaction submission for governance actions.
